name: ccmaf-skills
description: CCMAF Skills — production-grade, vendor-neutral skills for Claude Code and compatible agent runtimes, packaged as role/section packs plus an all-in-one plugin.

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills
plugins.description: All 72 CCMAF skills as one plugin. Every CCMAF skill as one plugin — senior-level engineering standards across languages, frameworks, cloud and operations, data, AI/agents, security and identity, plus agent-workflow and prose-quality disciplines. Prefer the role packs if you want a smaller skill listing.

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-core
plugins.description: Core — The agent-workflow disciplines every session benefits from: de-slopped prose, technical writing, docs-grounding, usage-limit hygiene, model calibration, systematic debugging, reviewable plans and recaps, committable diagrams, and the two shells. [Everyone — install this first.] (11 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering — The cross-cutting engineering disciplines: code review, secure development, test engineering, git workflow, architecture review, legacy modernisation, and Python as the general-purpose glue language. [Every developer, whatever the stack — install alongside core.] (7 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-web
plugins.description: Web & UI — Building web UIs that look chosen and behave well: HTML/CSS/Tailwind craft, React and Next.js, TypeScript, design taste, UX reasoning, accessibility, render-and-critique verification, and web performance. [Frontend and full-stack developers building user interfaces.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-backend
plugins.description: Backend & APIs — Services and the contracts between them: HTTP and GraphQL API design, .NET, Go and Rust, relational SQL, identity and auth, and event-driven architecture. [Backend and full-stack developers building services and data access.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure & Operations — Running software in production: Azure, Terraform/OpenTofu, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, and Linux as both workstation and server. [Platform, DevOps and SRE engineers, and anyone who ships to production.] (9 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-microsoft
plugins.description: Microsoft Business Platforms — The Microsoft business-application stack: Power Apps and Automate, Power Pages, Dynamics 365/Dataverse pro-code, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 development, Fabric, Power BI, and Sentinel/KQL. [Developers and makers on Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Fabric.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-ai
plugins.description: AI & Machine Learning — Software built on models: LLM applications and agents on the Claude API, retrieval-augmented generation as an engineered component, and classic/deep machine learning you train yourself. [Engineers building on LLMs or training their own models.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-data
plugins.description: Data — Moving and shaping data: vendor-neutral batch and streaming pipelines, ELT/dbt, orchestration, lakehouse modelling, data quality and contracts. [Data engineers and anyone moving or analysing data.] (1 skill)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-apps
plugins.description: Desktop & Mobile Apps — Native and cross-platform apps: Electron, Tauri, native Windows UI (WPF/WinUI/WinForms/MAUI), Android with Kotlin and Compose, and iOS with Swift and SwiftUI. [Developers shipping desktop or mobile applications.] (5 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-games
plugins.description: Games & 3D — Games and interactive 3D: Godot (engine, shaders, MCP-driven workflow), Unity, Unreal Engine 5, three.js, and the engine-agnostic craft of game feel. [Game developers and real-time 3D engineers.] (7 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-creative
plugins.description: Creative & Media — Code-driven creative tooling: Blender scripting and pipelines, ComfyUI image-generation workflows, and programmatic video with Remotion. [Artists, technical artists and video makers working with code.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-research
plugins.description: Research — Scholarly research done carefully: literature discovery, source appraisal, evidence synthesis and citation-safe referencing. [Researchers, students and anyone who needs citation-safe sources.] (1 skill)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-automation
plugins.description: Automation — Automating the web and repetitive work responsibly: scrapers and crawlers with a legal/ethical gate first. [Anyone automating the web or repetitive work.] (1 skill)
